description: Add the spec-definition viewer to Agora Studio: for any participant in the topology, render the koine contracts it advertises (KINP · KGP · KCB · KMI · KCS · KFT) together with its AgentCard / KCB manifest, each validated by `@agora/schemas` (the shared manifest schemas / protocol types — `schemas/src/agent-card.ts`, `manifest.ts`, `versions.ts`, `validate.ts`). The viewer renders what a participant is TOLD it advertises and validates it against the pinned koine spec versions — it never re-specifies a contract (contracts live in koine) and never fabricates conformance. Scope: the `studio/` workspace only, consuming `@agora/schemas` by reference. agora gates on `make check`.

userStories.title: Render a participant's advertised koine contracts + manifest
userStories.description: For a selected participant, render the koine contracts it advertises (KINP/KGP/KCB/KMI/KCS/KFT) and its AgentCard/KCB manifest, sourced from what the participant advertises at runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting a participant renders the koine contracts it advertises (any of KINP/KGP/KCB/KMI/KCS/KFT) plus its AgentCard / KCB manifest, sourced from the participant's advertised data (discovered/resolved), never a hard-wired roster or contract copy
A test asserts a participant advertising a subset of contracts renders exactly that subset (and a participant advertising none renders an empty spec view, consistent with the 60 empty backbone)
`make check` green (`npm run lint` + `npm run typecheck` + `vitest` for `studio/`)

userStories.title: Validate advertised specs against @agora/schemas
userStories.description: Validate each rendered AgentCard/manifest/contract against `@agora/schemas` and the pinned koine spec versions, showing pass/fail rather than assuming conformance.
acceptanceCriteria: Each advertised AgentCard/manifest/contract is validated with `@agora/schemas` (`agent-card.ts`/`manifest.ts`/`validate.ts`) against the koine spec versions pinned in `schemas/src/versions.ts`, and the viewer shows a per-artifact valid/invalid result — reusing the schemas package, never re-specifying a koine contract here
A test asserts a conformant manifest validates and a malformed / wrong-version one is flagged invalid with the schema/version reason surfaced (no fabricated pass)
`make check` green; Studio stays source-first and observer-only
